name: Xeno Jailburn
original_name: ゼノ・ジェイルバーン
source:
Lian's loyal guard dog, a lycanthrope wolf who makes a hobby of teaching her mistress incorrect information about how to seduce Jun and watching the results with a straight face (occasionally complimenting Lian at inappropriate times).  Her entire existence is focused on her mistress, though that doesn't seem to preclude what she considers play (the aforementioned manipulations).  Her Moon Ties ability allows her to liquify her body and enter tight spaces or hide inside her mistress's shadow, making her the ultimate unobtrusive servant and bodyguard.
[spoiler] During the true path, she comes to acknowledge Jun as her master as well.  In the past, she was deeply fond of Id, as it was his gift of blood that allowed her deformed body to obtain something close to physical perfection. [/spoiler]
